provided.title: File:Handcrafted beaded necklaces at Nairobi City Market in Kenya.jpg

observed.caption: Colorful beaded necklaces hanging on a wooden display board with dark blue fabric backing.
observed.description: Multiple strands of beaded necklaces in bright colors including red, yellow, blue, green, orange, white and black hang from metal hooks on a horizontal wooden bar mounted on a dark blue fabric-covered board framed by light wood. On the left and center are large circular collar-style necklaces with dense multicolor beadwork, in the center are smaller hoop necklaces, to the center-right hangs a cluster of black beaded necklaces with white and brown pendants, beside them are thin brown cord necklaces with a green and white pendant, on the right are long multistrand necklaces with yellow beads and light blue beads, one with a large ornate metal pendant with fringe at the bottom, and a partially visible green beaded strand on the far right edge.
